main_text.p: Falsa doctrina]Posteriorībus temporibus de-sciscent quidam à fide, spiritibus deceptoribus attendentes ac doctrinis dæmoniorum per hy-pocrisim falsiloquorum: quorum conscientia cauterio relecta est, prohibentium contrahere matrimonium, iubentiū abstinere à cibis, quos Deus creauit ad participandum cum gratia-rum actione fidelibus & iis qui cognouerunt veritatem. 1.Tim.4,1,2,3.IESVITARVM

Infania]Si quis diuersam docet doctrinam, neque accedit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri Iesu Christi, & ei quæ secundum pietatem est doctrinæ;is turget, nihil sciens, sed infaniés circa quæstiones ac verborum pugnas ex quibus nascitur inuidia, lis, maledicentiæ, suspiciones malæ, peruersæ exercitationes hominum mente corruptorū, & qui priuati sunt veritate, & quæ-stui habent pietatem. 1.Tim.6,3,4,5.

Inanis gloriatio] Auersare profanos de rebus inanibus clamores, & oppositiones falso nominatæ scientiæ: quam nonnulli [Iesuitæ hodie inter ceteros omnes sophistæ?] præ se ferentes, circa fidem aberrarunt à scopo. 1.Tim.6,20,21.
Profani clamores ] Profanos de rebus inanibus clamores cohibe: ad maiorem enim proce-dent impietatem. 2.Tim.2,16.

page.notes: The vertical label "IESVITARVM" in the left margin is treated as a margin note, placed in the first paragraph. "iubentiū" and "infaniés" are copied as printed; the macron and the letter forms are not fully certain. "sophistæ" in the bracketed phrase is partly obscured by a stain and is marked [?]. Headings XLV to XLIX are bare numbers and so are written as paragraphs. The paragraph headings "Falsa doctrina", "Infania" and similar are run-in italic words and are kept as paragraph openings.
